module: Flowgraph node "Request Abandon" (category logic, tag input). Lets the flow through, only once, when the player requests to abandon the mission. Pins: flow input; outputs flow (impulse) and value (hidden bool, true as long as the abandon is requested). If this node exists, the graph must be stopped manually at the end. data.blocksOnResetGameplay = true.
notes: The press is consumed: the flag is set back to false after the work and after the trigger (_afterTrigger). The event is recorded in the graph's log (logEvent "Player pressed 'Abandon'").

init.desc: Sets reset to false and data.blocksOnResetGameplay to true.

_executionStopped.desc: Sets reset back to false when the graph stops.

_executionStarted.desc: Sets reset back to false when the graph starts.

onRequestAbandon.desc: Hook called when the player requests to abandon; stores the request.

_afterTrigger.desc: Sets reset back to false after the trigger.

drawMiddle.desc: Editor: draws the central area of the node.

work.desc: If an abandon request is pending, enables flow and value (and logs), otherwise sets them to false.
